lead: Personal fragrance and its kit, organised as kind (olfactive family or format) → scent archetype → version (concentration, reformulation, batch) → detail, with house, perfumer and tradition registers.

b.v: body mist < eau fraîche < eau de cologne < eau de toilette < eau de parfum < parfum / extrait < attar (oil)
b.w: Standard perfumery naming; versions of one scent differ by concentration.

b.v: vintage original → reformulations → current batch (batch code)
b.w: Collectors compare vintages and batch codes; IFRA restrictions drive reformulation.
Fragrantica organises flankers and community-linked clones under the original scent.

depts.note: Scent is the archetype; concentrations, reformulations and flankers are versions. House and perfumer facts go in the registers.

b.w: Fragrantica community ratings and reviewer practice.
Niche and artisan houses market naturals; most fine fragrance blends both.
Batch codes, cellophane, cap and atomiser quality; counterfeits common for best-sellers.

s.brief: Organise on the Fragrantica / Michael Edwards fragrance-wheel axis. Each family kind holds archetype scents ordered by significance: genre-defining originators first (e.g. Chanel No 5, Shalimar, Mitsouko, Chypre de Coty, Fougère Royale, Jicky, Eau Sauvage, Angel, Aventus, Acqua di Giò, CK One, Opium, Cool Water, Le Labo Santal 33, Molecule 01, Baccarat Rouge 540, Terre d'Hermès, Portrait of a Lady), then reference modern icons. Versions = EDT/EDP/parfum, reformulations, notable flankers; clones listed as linked versions with their maker. Redistribute the ~70 old k1 models (incl. its Diptyque range) into the right family kinds as archetypes/versions; drop celebrity/SKU noise with no standing. mk must match the house register; add houses (Guerlain, Chanel, Dior, Hermès, Creed, Frédéric Malle, Diptyque, Serge Lutens, Le Labo, MFK, Amouage, Byredo, Tom Ford, Lattafa/Armaf for clones…) and a perfumer register entry list (Ernest Beaux, Jacques Guerlain, Edmond Roudnitska, Germaine Cellier, Jean-Claude Ellena, Dominique Ropion, Francis Kurkdjian, Olivier Cresp, Alberto Morillas…) to the brands file. Grasse tradition entry here.

k.brief: Single floral, floral bouquet, aldehydic floral, white floral. Old k1 models are redistributed from here across the shelf.
Classic, fruity, floral and leather chypres; Chypre de Coty as originator.
Fougère Royale originator; aromatic fougères.
Formerly 'oriental': Shalimar, Opium, Obsession; spicy and soft amber.
Sandalwood, cedar, vetiver, iso E super / ambroxan woody.
Farina / 4711 colognes, hesperidic and aromatic citrus.
Angel originator; vanilla, praline, ethyl maltol.
Cuir de Russie, Bandit, Tabac Blond lineage.
Calone era: New West, L'Eau d'Issey, Cool Water, Acqua di Giò.
Vent Vert, Chanel No 19, galbanum greens.
White musks, Molecule 01, Glossier You style skin scents.
Western/Arabian-house alcohol oud scents (M7, Oud Wood, Amouage, Arabian houses); oil ouds go to the attar shelf.

s.brief: Alcohol-free oil perfumes and traditional distillates. Archetypes are named traditional attars (gulab/rose of Kannauj and Taif, mitti, shamama, hina, ruh khus, majmua, musk tahara, dehn al oud origins: Hindi, Cambodi, Assam, Borneo). Makers: Kannauj distillers, Arabian houses (Ajmal, Abdul Samad Al Qurashi, Swiss Arabian, Asgharali), artisan oud distillers. Redistribute old k3 models; drop shop-only SKUs. Add tradition entries: Kannauj deg-bhapka attar distillation; Arabian oud & oil perfumery (incl. Taif rose).

k.brief: Modern oil-based and roll-on perfume oils; generic oil versions of fine fragrances.
Kannauj attars: gulab, mitti, hina, shamama, majmua, ruh khus, kewra.
Agarwood oil by origin and distillation; aged and wild vs cultivated.
Taif, Bulgarian and Kannauj rose otto/attar for wearing.
White musk, musk tahara, Egyptian musk (synthetic; natural deer musk restricted).
Arabian blended oils of oud, rose, amber and musk.

s.brief: Light and alternative-format fragrance. Archetypes = best-selling and cult scents (Bath & Body Works Japanese Cherry Blossom, Victoria's Secret Bombshell/Love Spell mists, Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62, Gisou hair perfume, Lush solids). Trim old k2's long Bath & Body Works SKU list to its icons. Solid-perfume compacts that are collectibles go to the bottles dept note.

k.brief: Body sprays and fragrance mists, incl. hair & body mists.
Low-alcohol hair mists; house versions of fine fragrances are versions of that scent.

s.brief: Collector bottles: archetypes are named bottle designs (Lalique for Coty, Baccarat for Guerlain Shalimar, Schiaparelli Shocking torso, Dalí for Schiaparelli, Jean Paul Gaultier torso), antique scent bottles (Georgian/Victorian, chatelaine, lay-down), Czech crystal, factices, Egyptian hand-blown attar bottles. Then practical refillable atomisers (Travalo-type, bulb atomisers). Add traditions: Czech/Bohemian perfume-bottle glass, Egyptian hand-blown glass if sourced. Note: bottles that are art glass keep a cross-link to F2.
